sentences.en: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!
sentences.zh: 我父母老是为一些无聊的事情争吵，真是烦人!

sentences.en: Which of your parents do you take after in character?
sentences.zh: 你是从你父亲那边还是母亲那边继承的性格多一点?

sentences.en: Parents who beat their children really make my blood boil.
sentences.zh: 看到打孩子的父母我就气不打一处来。

senses.zh: 父母，双亲；（动植物的）亲本
